command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
review="$reports/review-specs.md"
added=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- "$review" | tail -1)
base=HEAD
[ -z "$added" ] || base="$added^"
touched=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -vxF "$review" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$touched" ] || { echo "$touched"; echo "the review-specs stage writes nothing but $review - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: Missed WARNING: design.md D5 'Frame' (design.md:134) makes the hour frame 'the last child of the <ul>', an <li> with 'rounded-lg border-2 border-accent', while D5 'Panel' (design.md:131) keeps the <ul>'s 'border and dividers unchanged'. That <ul> carries 'divide-y divide-border' (packages/client/src/views/shared/locationRowVariant.ts:47). On Tailwind ^3.4.17 (packages/client/package.json:69), divide-y styles every following child through '.divide-y > :not([hidden]) ~ :not([hidden])', setting 'border-top-width: 1px; border-bottom-width: 0', and divide-border sets border-color the same way. These selectors are more specific than .border-2 and .border-accent, so the frame would get a 1 px top border, no bottom border and the border token colour instead of the accent. This contradicts proposal.md FR8 ('An hour frame in the accent colour') and UX1, and the review neither raises it as a finding nor lists it under Consistency. A fix would render the frame outside the divided children or exclude it from divide-y (e.g. move the dividers to the row <li>s for GRID_ROW).

R1's Fix is imprecise: it asks for the sticky header and notes wrappers to 'get `relative z-[2]` (sticky already positions them)'. relative and sticky both set `position`, so adding `relative` to a box that must stay sticky contradicts D5's 'sticky left-0' box. The fix should say only `z-[2]` on the sticky wrappers.
